reviews.summary: 对 NocoBase3 基础框架(库/插件/指引)的独立评审，以 issue #708 的“到期待办自动过期”为用例。共评估 5 个能力单元：调度插件、db 与数据指引、服务路由与依赖注入、认证与会话、客户端路由与权限。整体结论：库与 Skill 的职责边界、装配契约和幂等指引质量高，应用在修复流程后二轮验收 B01–B03 全部通过；主要框架侧不足集中在 Scheduler 授权目录(settings)与路由校验(page)资源不一致，以及应用开发主路由指引未暴露 cookie 写入的 Origin/CSRF 规则；首轮验收失败经证据归因于工厂 db apply 流程与“示例数据”措辞对 sample 语义的冲突，而非框架缺陷，且该语义在框架类型与 Skill 中表述正确。评审为只读，未运行应用；浏览器截图未由评审者渲染查看，故 UI 维度不评分。

modules.name: M1 调度能力 (Scheduler 插件 + Skill)
modules.scope: 评估 @nocobase/app-plugin-scheduler 的公开 API、目标扩展点、触发/记账可靠性，以及其配套 Skill 是否给出正确的接入与幂等指引。业务场景为“到期待办自动过期”。
modules.limitations: 只读编译产物与 Skill 文本；运行期证据来自应用与验收日志，未复现多实例/redis 场景。

requirements.need: 应用需要一个“按计划触发、并能承认上次触发/完成状态”的调度能力。
requirements.responsibility: 插件提供 defineSchedule/registerTarget 与 occurrence 记账；业务逻辑由应用 target 承担。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 Provider 的 boot() 中把 schedulerServiceToken 注入的服务与 registerTarget/defineSchedule 组合，先 has(token) 守卫。
requirements.actualUsage: TodoServiceProvider 在 register() 绑定 TodoService，在 boot() 中注册 app.todo target 并 defineSchedule(每分钟)；验收 B01/B02 通过。

requirements.need: 同一次计划触发被重复分发(重启/重试)时，业务不得产生重复副作用。
requirements.responsibility: store 层按 occurrence 去重，应用 target 需实现业务幂等。
requirements.recommendedUsage: target.execute 对同一 occurrenceId 幂等(返回既有结果)；业务写用条件更新而非插入。
requirements.actualUsage: markExpired 用 completed=false AND expired=false AND dueAt<now 的条件更新，多次运行不新增记录；B02 验证无重复。

requirements.need: 管理员需要看到调度是否按计划运行，而不仅是任务是否成功。
requirements.responsibility: 插件保留 occurrence 历史与运行状态维度，应用自建管理页消费其 API。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 operations.md 的三层状态区分“已触发/执行成功/业务达成”，并通过路由器暴露的 API 查询 occurrence。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用用 authz:skip 的 schedules 页面消费 Scheduler API 展示运行情况；验收 B01/B03 通过。

requirements.need: 按插件自身授权目录给非管理员授予调度页权限即可访问调度 API。
requirements.responsibility: 插件应把“目录项/授权资源”与“路由校验资源”对齐，或提供页面级资源。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 应用在客户端声明 page 资源并配 authz，或依赖服务端 403 兜底。
requirements.actualUsage: 插件 authorization 只注册 settings:scheduler.schedules/read，而路由要 page:scheduler.schedules/access；应用改用 authz:"skip" + API 自检，并加 server/AGENTS.md 说明。

requirementFit.reason: 调度触发、occurrence 去重与历史查询能力齐全；Skill 对职责边界和幂等的指引与实际 API 一致，应用据此在 B01/B02 通过。

usability.reason: registerTarget/defineSchedule 的接入步骤清楚、有守卫范式；但授权目录与路由资源不一致，使“照目录授权”无法直接可用。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 明确 boot() 注册时机、重复类型报错与命令式定义，Agent 能直接落地；仍需跨到 operations.md 才能发现授权资源差异。

design.reason: 公开面只暴露 token 与接口，存储/注册表/历史私有，扩展点单一，边界清晰。

reliability.reason: store 层以条件更新保证 occurrence 只记一次，应用层幂等漏失也不会造成重复数据；授权资源不一致属接口一致性问题，不影响调度正确性。

modules.name: M2 数据与迁移 (db 库 + 数据 Skill/指引)
modules.scope: 评估 @nocobase/db 的迁移/种子定义 API 与 sample 语义，以及 nocobase-db / app-development 指引对“结构 vs 安装数据 vs 样例数据”的表述。
modules.limitations: 未运行数据库；结论来自类型、编译实现、Skill 文本与应用种子/迁移代码及工厂 db apply 记录。

requirements.need: 应用需要可版本化的表结构定义。
requirements.responsibility: db 库提供 defineMigration + Collection builder，由 db apply 发现并执行。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 把迁移放 database/main/migrations 并用 builder.createCollection 声明字段/索引。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用迁移以 increments/string/datetime/boolean 建 todos 并加 dueAt、expired 索引。

requirements.need: 应用需要幂等的初始数据装载，重复 apply 不重复插入。
requirements.responsibility: defineSeed 定义种子，按唯一业务键幂等；sample 种子只在装载样例数据时运行。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用普通种子(非 sample)承载安装所需数据，并以 upsertOne/唯一键实现幂等。
requirements.actualUsage: 种子先以 title 业务键 findOne+createOne 幂等，但初期写成 sample:true，导致 db apply 记为 skipped、首轮验收库为空(B01/B02 失败)。

requirements.need: 工厂的 db apply 流程需要把任务所称“示例数据/种子”语义与 sample 语义对齐。
requirements.responsibility: db/Skill 已正确区分安装数据与样例数据，工厂流程也需匹配。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 工厂要么用普通种子承载初始数据，要么显式运行 db sample/设置 APP_SAMPLE_DATA。
requirements.actualUsage: repair 将种子改为普通(仍幂等)种子后，第二轮 B01–B03 全部通过。

requirementFit.reason: 迁移/种子 API 完整且被应用直接采用；sample 与安装数据语义明确，唯一致命点来自工厂流程与任务措辞而非库能力。

usability.reason: 定义式 API 与目录约定学习成本低，样本种子语义有专门文档与类型字段支撑。

agentFriendliness.reason: db SKILL 对“迁移建结构、种子装数据、样例非安装数据”有直接可检索的表述，Agent 首次即按 Skill 选择了 sample:true。

design.reason: 迁移/种子/样例三类职责边界清晰，定义与执行分离，sample 语义是显式元数据而非约定。

reliability.reason: 迁移与种子加载路径稳定，sample 判定拒绝在非样例场景执行，避免样例数据污染真实库。

modules.name: M3 服务路由与依赖注入 (app-server/service-provider + 相关指引)
modules.scope: 评估 @nocobase/app-server 的路由服务契约、@nocobase/service-provider 的 token 与生命周期，以及 app-development 指引对装配与路由安全的描述。
modules.limitations: 只读类型/实现与 Skill；未验证多插件贡献顺序等运行期边界。

requirements.need: 应用需要能在插件化装配中声明并暴露 HTTP 路由。
requirements.responsibility: app-server 以服务形式持有 Hono 路由并提供 defineApiRoutes 等贡献契约。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在路由文件中用 defineApiRoutes 返回 createRouter，token 从定义处导入。
requirements.actualUsage: todos 路由用 defineApiRoutes + authenticationToken + auth.required() 暴露 GET/PATCH。

requirements.need: 跨模块共享服务需要用稳定的身份而不是全局单例。
requirements.responsibility: service-provider 以 createServiceToken 的对象身份做容器 key，ServiceProvider 提供 register/boot 生命周期。
requirements.recommendedUsage: token 定义在服务旁并导入复用；register() 绑定、boot() 做需要其他服务的工作。
requirements.actualUsage: TodoServiceProvider 在 register() 以 container.singleton 绑定，在 boot() 装配 target；token 由应用创建一次。

requirements.need: 每条业务路由必须自行保证认证，不能依赖他人中间件。
requirements.responsibility: server-routes 指引要求路由自负安全并给出 auth.required() 范式。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在路由上直接挂 auth.required()（及需要时的 authorization.middleware()）。
requirements.actualUsage: todos 路由挂 auth.required()；但 cookie 写入的来源校验需另配 trustedOrigins(详见 M4/F3)。

requirementFit.reason: 路由贡献契约与 token 化 DI 组成完整闭环，应用无需变通即可声明受保护路由并共享服务。

usability.reason: 生命周期表与 token 身份说明清晰；但“路由自负安全”段落未覆盖 cookie 写入边界。

agentFriendliness.reason: services-and-jobs 的 register/boot 表让 Agent 能快速定位装配时机，token 复用规则明确。

design.reason: 路由作为服务而非应用本身，配合定义式贡献与身份化 token，隔离度好、可组合。

reliability.reason: 生命周期钩子与服务 token 的实现稳定，容器按身份匹配避免同名冲突。

modules.name: M4 认证与会话 (authentication 插件 + 相关 Skill)
modules.scope: 评估 @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication 的 cookie 写入来源校验实现，以及 authentication Skill 对 CSRF/trustedOrigins 的文档化程度。
modules.limitations: 未运行认证流程；结论来自实现源码、Skill 文本与首轮 403 日志/应用修复记录。

requirements.need: 应用路由需要对匿名请求拒绝访问。
requirements.responsibility: 认证插件提供 auth.required()/authenticationToken 会话中间件。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在路由上挂 auth.required()，由插件解析会话。
requirements.actualUsage: todos 路由使用 auth.required()，未自行实现认证(B01/B03 通过)。

requirements.need: 浏览器 cookie 会话下的写入必须防 CSRF，且应用应知道如何配置信任来源。
requirements.responsibility: 认证插件对带 cookie 的非安全方法校验 Origin/Referer，可通过 auth.trustedOrigins 配置，失败返回 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在应用配置 trustedOrigins/publicOrigin，并在写入请求携带受信 origin；见 protecting-routes.md:44。
requirements.actualUsage: 首轮 PATCH 测试因缺 Origin 得 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN；agent 自行加 trustedOrigins+origin 头并把规则写入 server/AGENTS.md，随后通过。

requirementFit.reason: 认证中间件与 CSRF 来源校验实现完整，行为与 Skill 记录一致，应用经一次修复后满足验收。

usability.reason: 规则在 authentication Skill 内表述清楚，但应用开发主路径(server-routes/AGENTS 路由表)未暴露该规则，Agent 需自行发现并补文档。

agentFriendliness.reason: 缺乏面向“加路由”的交叉引用，Agent 首轮在测试阶段才以 403 撞上该规则；错误码与 Skill 文本可查是其主要友好点。

design.reason: 把 CSRF 来源校验做成中间件内的可配置策略，并给出明确错误码，边界清楚。

reliability.reason: 来源校验对 GET/HEAD/OPTIONS 与无 cookie 请求放行、否则失败关闭，实现完整且可配置。

modules.name: M5 客户端路由与权限 (app-client + UI 工作流指引)
modules.scope: 评估 @nocobase/app-client 的路由贡献与 auth/authz 模型，以及 ui-workflow 指引对完成标准与验证的要求。
modules.limitations: 评审模型无法渲染图像，未查看浏览器截图；结论限于类型/实现、指引与验收报告文本。

requirements.need: 应用需要声明受认证/授权的页面路由。
requirements.responsibility: app-client 以 defineAppRoutes 声明确式路由，auth/authz 在路径首页声明并可继承。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 对业务页声明 auth:"required" 与明确的 authz page 资源；配置页可用其 settings 项。
requirements.actualUsage: client/routes.ts 用 defineAppRoutes 声明 home/inbox/todos/schedules，均 auth:required；schedules 因后端 API 自检而 authz:skip。

requirements.need: Scheduler 管理页应受 Scheduler 授权资源保护而与后端校验一致。
requirements.responsibility: 客户端 authz 与插件后端路由应指向同一资源。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在路径首页按插件目录声明 page/scheduler.schedules/access。
requirements.actualUsage: 因插件只注册 settings 项，应用改为 authz:skip 并依赖 API 403 兜底(F2 的应用侧绕行)。

requirements.need: 前端改动需要有明确的完成标准与验证方式。
requirements.responsibility: ui-workflow 指引给出三种工作流与完成定义。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按改动范围选择工作流，并以工作流要求的证据判定完成。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用与验收按完整流程产出页面并截图；B01/B03 通过（截图未由评审者查看）。

requirementFit.reason: 路由/auth/authz 模型足以表达受保护页面，应用据此完成页面；唯 authz 资源需与插件后端自洽。

usability.reason: authz 继承/首页声明规则清楚，defineAppRoutes 用法直观；但需理解后端 API 才能正确设置 authz。

agentFriendliness.reason: 类型注释直接说明 authz 省略时的继承语义，配合 ui-workflow 完成标准，Agent 能自证前端完成。

design.reason: 路由贡献为静态声明并在 resolve 阶段统一处理，auth/authz 与导航分离，扩展点清晰。

reliability.reason: defineAppRoutes 冻结贡献对象、递归冻结子路由，避免声明被意外修改；运行期权限仍依赖后端兜底。

findings.title: Scheduler 以单一公共服务与私有存储划清扩展边界，并明确要求业务幂等
findings.detail: 插件只公开 schedulerServiceToken 与 registerTarget/defineSchedule，把 target 注册表、schedule 存储与 occurrence 历史留在内部；store 层对同一 occurrence 的重复 start 以条件更新只记一次，Skill 进一步要求 target.execute 业务幂等并把“已分发/已成功/业务达成”拆成三种状态。应用据此把 markExpired 写成条件更新，B01/B02 通过。
findings.impact: Agent 无需理解插件内部即可安全接入，且框架层面已把“重复触发不产生重复副作用”的责任显式化。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持现状；可在应用侧把 markExpired 的幂等断言纳入测试。

findings.title: Scheduler 授权目录注册的是 settings 项，而路由校验 page 资源，按插件目录授权仍会 403
findings.detail: authorization.js 只向 settings 目录注册 scheduler.schedules/read；routes/index.js 在全部 schedule API 前要求 {type:"page",id:"scheduler.schedules"}/access，否则 403 SCHEDULE_ACCESS_REQUIRED。operations.md:11-13 也确认插件不贡献页面、由应用自建并加 page 授权。二者资源类型不一致，应用只能改用 authz:"skip" + API 自检。
findings.impact: 管理员按插件自身授权目录授予“调度查看”后，管理页 API 仍 403；应用需理解隐藏的 page 资源约定并自行兜底，增加接入成本与误配风险。
findings.suggestedChange: 由插件注册对应 page/authz 项，或在授权目录与路由间统一资源类型，并补一条“仅凭目录授权即可访问 API”的测试。

diagnosis.trigger: 应用按插件授权目录为非管理员授予 scheduler.schedules/read，然后打开自建调度管理页调用其 API。
diagnosis.expected: 目录授予的读权限即足以访问调度 API，或授权目录与路由校验同一资源类型。
diagnosis.actual: 路由校验 page:scheduler.schedules/access，目录只含 settings:scheduler.schedules/read，请求得 403 SCHEDULE_ACCESS_REQUIRED。
diagnosis.workaround: 客户端将该页声明为 authz:"skip" 并完全依赖服务端 403 兜底；或自行声明 page 资源并配 authz。
diagnosis.acceptance: 插件注册 page 级资源或统一目录/路由资源类型，并覆盖“仅 settings 授权”和“page 授权”两种用户的验收用例。

feedbackReview.reason: 源码与授权模型一致支持该结论。authorization.js 只注册 settings 项 scheduler.schedules/read(E4,E6)，routes/index.js 在全部 schedule API 前要求 page:scheduler.schedules/access 并返回 403 SCHEDULE_ACCESS_REQUIRED(E5,E28)。授权核心 grantBacked 按 request.resource.type:id 匹配 grants(E66)，而 settings.grant 产出 type 'settings'(E64)、page.grant 产出 type 'page'(E65)，二者无跨类型映射，故仅授予插件目录的 settings 项无法满足路由的 page 校验，触发条件成立。应用侧已改用 authz:'skip'+API 403 兜底(E46,E63)，与该结论一致。替代解释“应用可自行声明 page 资源”只提供另一条路径，并不能否定“按插件自身授权目录授权仍会 403”这一具体触发。

checks.reason: 插件授权目录只声明 settings:scheduler.schedules/read(E4,E6,E64)，而插件文档与路由声明的访问条件是 page:scheduler.schedules/access(E5,E28)；授权核心把 settings 与 page 当独立资源类型(E65,E66)。

processNotes.author: implementer
processNotes.summary: Built the minimal overdue-todo scheduling verification: one `todos` table (migration + idempotent seed of 3 records), a `todos.check-expired` Scheduler target/schedule that runs `markExpired()` idempotently, a todos page and a Scheduler page, and tests covering migration, service/seed, routes, real dispatch, and the UI. Repair round: the seed was declared `sample: true`, which the factory's `nocobase db apply` records as skipped (it never sets APP_SAMPLE_DATA or runs `db sample`), so the verification database came up empty and neither expiry marking nor idempotency could be observed. Converted it to a plain, still idempotent seed so `db apply` loads the 3 records.

blockers.title: Cookie-authenticated PATCH rejected with 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN
blockers.symptom: Authenticated session worked for GET /api/todos, but PATCH /api/todos/:id returned 403 {"error":{"reason":"INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN","domain":"authentication"}}.
blockers.rootCause: The authentication plugin's checkCookieWriteOrigin middleware requires a trusted Origin/Referer on cookie-authenticated non-GET requests. Tests did not send one.
blockers.resolution: Configured auth.trustedOrigins: ['http://localhost'] in the test app config and sent origin: 'http://localhost' on write requests. Documented in server/AGENTS.md.

blockers.title: Component test asserted toHaveBeenLastCalledWith while the page reloads after a write
blockers.symptom: The PATCH was observed in the mock call list but the assertion still failed because the page immediately refetched the list, making the GET the last call.
blockers.rootCause: Assertion assumed the write was the final request; the page reloads the list after a successful write.
blockers.resolution: Assert with toHaveBeenCalledWith instead of toHaveBeenLastCalledWith. Also switched in-table action clicks from userEvent to fireEvent, which is reliable in this jsdom setup.

blockers.title: Verification database empty: sample seed never loaded by the factory database step
blockers.symptom: Scheduler ran every minute and recorded executions, but every result was `Marked 0 todo(s) expired` and `/main/api/todos` returned `{"data":[],"meta":{"total":0}}`; the three required todos (overdue, future, completed) did not exist, so neither B01 (only overdue incomplete marked) nor B02 (repeat run adds nothing) could be observed.
blockers.rootCause: The three records were declared `sample: true`. The factory applies seeds with `pnpm exec nocobase db apply` against a fresh connection and never runs `db sample` or sets `APP_SAMPLE_DATA`; the DB/CLI docs state such seeds are recorded as skipped and never run, so the verification database always installs empty.
blockers.resolution: Renamed `202610070002_sample_todos.ts` to `202610070002_default_todos.ts` and removed `sample: true`, making it a plain idempotent seed keyed on title. Verified with a fresh temp runtime config that `nocobase db apply` loads exactly 3 records without APP_SAMPLE_DATA and a second apply leaves the count at 3.

improvements.title: Scheduler plugin route and catalog permissions disagree
improvements.detail: The scheduler routes check page:{id: 'scheduler.schedules'}/access (settingsAccess), while the plugin's pages-authorization catalog registers a `settings` resource with a `read` action. Building a client page therefore cannot rely on a client-side resource guard; authz:'skip' plus server-side enforcement is the working choice.
improvements.suggestedChange: Align the scheduler plugin's client catalog registration with the page access resource its routes enforce.

improvements.title: Strict i18n runtime demands the exact key, including plural branch keys
improvements.detail: The test runtime installs a missingKeyHandler that throws MissingTranslationError for any absent key. A one-character group typo surfaces as a plural key such as schedules.occurrence.expiredCount_one, which reads as confusing stack noise rather than the real mismatch.
improvements.suggestedChange: When a missing key ends in a plural suffix (_one/_other), include the resolved base key in the error message.

improvements.title: Sample-data tasks cannot pass because the database step skips sample seeds
improvements.detail: Tasks marked 示例数据：是 are verified by `apply-database.sh`, which runs `nocobase db apply` with APP_SAMPLE_DATA unset and never runs `db sample`. Any `defineSeed({ sample: true })` is recorded skipped, so a task whose acceptance reads seeded records fails no matter how correct the implementation is; the only working option is a plain seed, which contradicts the sample-data guidance.
improvements.suggestedChange: Have `apply-database.sh` (or the runtime config it uses) set `APP_SAMPLE_DATA=true` for sample-data tasks, or run `pnpm exec nocobase db sample` after `db apply`, so declared sample seeds load during verification.

Use the installed version's public exports, without importing plugin internals. The application owns business logic, schedule declarations, Providers, permissions, and deployment timing. Scheduler owns scheduling projections, trigger history, and execution state. The plugin's `skills/` directory is the source of truth; do not edit the synchronized application copy under `.agents/skills/`.

## Decide Whether to Use Scheduler

The primary reason to define tasks through Scheduler is **UI observability for business administrators**. Developers define schedules and execution logic in code. Business administrators use the task list and detail pages the application builds on the Scheduler API to view schedules, track individual executions, and enable or disable tasks when authorized.

Tasks that do not need to be viewed and tracked through the UI must not be managed by the Scheduler plugin. Give recurring ones a `ScheduleExecutor` of their own from the application's jobs service (`jobExecutorServiceToken` in `@nocobase/app-server/jobs`), and one-off background work a `JobExecutor`; the application development Skill describes both. For administrator-visible tasks, deliver Client registration, access permissions, meaningful task names, and accurate final execution status together; successful server-side dispatch alone is incomplete.

evidence.excerpt: A schedule points at a target, and a target is the plugin's one extension point: `scheduler.registerTarget(target)` declares how a configuration is validated, how a firing starts, and — for work that finishes later — how a run is inspected and reported. Register targets in their owning Provider's `boot()`: all Providers have registered services, and Scheduler has not yet synchronized the manifest in `start()`. Do not resolve the container during module import or depend on another Provider's boot order to create services. Duplicate target types throw.

Register `@nocobase/app-plugin-scheduler/client` in `client/plugins.ts`; it contributes no pages, only the locales for the titles its server registers with the authorization catalog. A migration creates structure. A seed inserts the records the application needs in order to run. Neither does the other's job. Sample or demonstration content is not install data: declare it as a sample seed, described below, never as a plain seed.

evidence.excerpt:
- **A seed is idempotent**, keyed on a stable business value backed by a unique constraint, so a repeated run is a no-op — `upsertOne` is the direct way to express that. A seed context has no `builder` at all, and a seed has no rollback or truncate behavior.

A backfill belongs in the migration that makes it necessary, using `query` from the same context — not in a seed.

Sample data goes in the same `seeds` directory, declared with `defineSeed({ name, sample: true, run })`. It runs only when the application installs its database with `app.sampleData` set (`APP_SAMPLE_DATA=true`): the connection held no migration or seed history before that start, or `db reset` rebuilt it. Otherwise the seed is recorded as skipped and never runs on its own; `pnpm nocobase db sample` runs every skipped sample seed in development, and a deployment refuses it. Sample data that has to go through other plugins' services, such as projects with issues, is registered instead on `sampleDataToken` from `@nocobase/app-server/sample-data`, from a service provider's `boot()`: `container.resolve(sampleDataToken).register({ name, packageName, run })`. Migrations under `database/main/migrations/` are the application's schema history. Seeds under `database/main/seeds/` insert records the application requires to run. Migrations create structure. Seeds never do.

`database/tsconfig.json` extends the server configuration so editor tooling and ESLint recognize migrations and seeds as Node source. Keep it in place when adding connection directories.

## Running

```bash
pnpm nocobase db apply
```

This applies pending migrations and then pending seeds for `database.default`, including registered plugins, ordered by name across all sources. Both halves run only what is pending, so on an already-migrated database it applies seeds alone. The template defaults to `main`. Plugin migrations, seeds and runtime default reads/writes always use this same connection; changing `database.default` changes the application system database.

Seeds are the second half of that run, so the structure a seed writes into must already exist from an earlier migration. Keep seed data fixed and reproducible — no current timestamps or random values in identifying fields — and never let a repeat run silently overwrite data a user has edited.

Sample data is not required data. Put it in the same `seeds` directory as `defineSeed({ name, sample: true, run })`, or, when it has to go through plugins' services, register it on `sampleDataToken` from `@nocobase/app-server/sample-data` in a service provider's `boot()`; `.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md` section 2 has the details. **Public origin.** Set `app.publicOrigin` to the HTTPS address the browser
sees. Better Auth derives its base URL and callback URLs from it and from the
application's public base path; a container-internal address breaks OAuth
callbacks and cookie attributes. The reverse proxy must forward host,
protocol, and cookies.

**Business request CSRF.** `Auth.required()` and `Auth.optional()` reject cookie-bearing writes unless `Origin` (or, when absent, `Referer`) matches Better Auth's configured base origin or a trusted origin. Configure `app.publicOrigin` for deployed applications and add separate frontend origins through `auth.trustedOrigins`; without a trusted origin, browser writes fail closed with `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, reason `INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN`, in the standard error body. # Pick the email/password refs out of the snapshot, then:
agent-browser fill @e3 "user@example.com"
agent-browser fill @e4 "hunter2"

Credentials in shell history are a leak. For anything sensitive, use the auth vault (see [references/authentication.md](references/authentication.md)):

```bash
agent-browser auth save my-app --url https://app.example.com/login \
  --username user@example.com --password-stdin
# (type password, Ctrl+D)

agent-browser auth login my-app    # fills + clicks, waits for form
```

If credentials live in an external vault, use a configured credential provider plugin instead of putting secrets in the command line:

```bash
agent-browser plugin add agent-browser-plugin-vault --name vault
agent-browser plugin list
agent-browser auth login my-app --credential-provider vault --item "My App"
agent-browser auth login my-app --credential-provider vault --item "My App" --url https://app.example.com/login --username-selector "#email" --password-selector "#password"
```

Plugins can also provide browser providers, launch mutators such as stealth setup, and arbitrary namespaced commands:

```bash
agent-browser --provider cloud-browser open https://example.com
agent-browser plugin run captcha captcha.solve --payload '{"siteKey":"...","url":"https://example.com"}'
```

`plugin run` is for `command.run` and custom capabilities. Core capabilities and protocol request types use their dedicated command paths.

### Persist session across runs

```bash
# Derive one stable id for this agent/worktree
SESSION="$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix my-app)"

# Pass the same id and restore request on every command
agent-browser --session "$SESSION" --restore open https://app.example.com
```

`--restore` with no value uses the current `--session` as the persistence key. Agent skills should prefer this over hand-built state file paths. Use `--restore-save auto` by default so a failed restore does not overwrite the previous known-good state. State is saved on close and also periodically while the browser is open (at most once per `AGENT_BROWSER_AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL_MS`, default 30000), so state survives even if the user closes the browser window by hand.

```bash
agent-browser --session "$SESSION" --restore --restore-check-text Dashboard open https://app.example.com
agent-browser --session "$SESSION" session info --json
```

### Extract data

```bash
# Structured snapshot (best for AI reasoning over page content)
agent-browser snapshot -i --json > page.json

# Targeted extraction with refs
agent-browser snapshot -i
agent-browser get text @e5
agent-browser get attr @e10 href

# Arbitrary shape via JavaScript
cat <<'EOF' | agent-browser eval --stdin
const rows = document.querySelectorAll("table tbody tr");
Array.from(rows).map(r => ({
  name: r.cells[0].innerText,
  price: r.cells[1].innerText,
}));
EOF
```

Prefer `eval --stdin` (heredoc) or `eval -b <base64>` for any JS with quotes or special characters. Inline `agent-browser eval "..."` works only for simple expressions.

### Screenshot

```bash
agent-browser screenshot                        # temp path, printed on stdout
agent-browser screenshot page.png               # specific path
agent-browser screenshot --full full.png        # full scroll height
agent-browser screenshot --annotate map.png     # numbered labels + legend keyed to snapshot refs
```

Headless Chromium screenshots hide native scrollbars for consistent image output. Pass `--hide-scrollbars false` when launching to keep native scrollbars visible.

`--annotate` is designed for multimodal models: each label `[N]` maps to ref `@eN`.

### Handle multiple pages via tabs

```bash
agent-browser tab                      # list open tabs (with stable tabId)
agent-browser tab new https://docs...  # open a new tab (and switch to it)
agent-browser tab t2                   # switch to tab t2
agent-browser tab close t2             # close tab t2
```

Stable `tabId`s mean `t2` points at the same tab across commands even when other tabs open or close. After switching, refs from a prior snapshot on a different tab no longer apply — re-snapshot. `tab list --json` also reports each tab's CDP `targetId`, accepted anywhere a tab ref is accepted; target ids stay stable across daemon restarts, unlike `t<N>` ids.

Switching has two special cases worth knowing:

- **Discarded tab (Chrome Memory Saver).** A backgrounded tab may have its renderer dropped. Switching to it reactivates the tab, which reloads the page and discards unsaved state (form input, scroll position). The switch result then includes `"revived": true`, so treat prior in-page state as gone and re-snapshot. Closing the active tab onto a discarded successor reports `"activeTabRevived": true` for the same reason.
- **Tab blocked by a dialog.** If the target tab has an open dialog (`confirm`/`prompt`, or `alert`/`beforeunload` under `--no-auto-dialog`) its renderer is paused, not discarded, so the switch leaves it untouched and reports `"dialogBlocked": true`. Resolve the dialog with `dialog accept`/`dialog dismiss` before interacting with the page.

### Run multiple browsers in parallel

Each `--session <name>` is an isolated browser with its own cookies, tabs, and refs. For agent skills, derive stable names with `agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix <skill>`. Useful for testing multi-user flows or parallel scraping:

```bash
agent-browser --session a open https://app.example.com
agent-browser --session b open https://app.example.com
agent-browser --session a fill @e1 "alice@test.com"
agent-browser --session b fill @e1 "bob@test.com"
```

`AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION=myapp` sets the default session for the current shell.

When several sessions share one Chrome over `--cdp <port>`, add `--pin-tab` so each session sticks to its own tab. Every session remembers its bound tab across daemon restarts; with `--pin-tab` a command whose bound tab was closed fails with a `tab_gone` error instead of acting on another session's tab. JSON output includes `"code": "tab_gone"`, `data.targetId`, and an optional sanitized `data.lastUrl` for recovery. Recover with `tab new <url>` or pick a tab from `tab list`. The flag is sticky per session, so pass it once (`--no-pin-tab` turns it off again). See `references/session-management.md` for details.

### Mock network requests

```bash
agent-browser network route "**/api/users" --body '{"users":[]}'   # stub a response
agent-browser network route "**/analytics" --abort                 # block entirely
agent-browser network requests                                     # inspect what fired
agent-browser network har start                                    # record all traffic
# ... perform actions ...
agent-browser network har stop /tmp/trace.har

# HAR files embed text response bodies (JSON/HTML/JS) by default, so the
# recording alone is enough to study a site's API offline. Use
# `--content all` to include binary bodies or `--content none` to disable.
```

### Record a video of the workflow

```bash
agent-browser open https://example.com
agent-browser record start demo.webm
agent-browser snapshot -i
agent-browser click @e3
agent-browser record stop
```

See [references/video-recording.md](references/video-recording.md) for codec options, GIF export, and more.

### Iframes

Iframes are auto-inlined in the snapshot — their refs work transparently:

```bash
agent-browser snapshot -i
# @e3 [Iframe] "payment-frame"
#   @e4 [input] "Card number"
#   @e5 [button] "Pay"

agent-browser fill @e4 "4111111111111111"
agent-browser click @e5
```

To scope a snapshot to an iframe (for focus or deep nesting):

```bash
agent-browser frame @e3      # switch context to the iframe
agent-browser snapshot -i
agent-browser frame main     # back to main frame
```
